name: Alle'nora Annie's Signature Salon
msg:
Assalam o alaikum! Main Alle'nora Annie's ke Google reviews dekh raha tha - 406 reviews aur 4.1 stars, mashallah. Lekin listing par website koi nahi thi.

To maine aap ke liye ek website bana di hai. Video mein dekh lein, ya khud phone par khol kar dekhein:
https://aayan-cloud.github.io/website-mockups/allenora-salon/

Ye maine free banai hai. Agar pasand aaye to PKR 15,000 se 25,000 mein aap ki ho jayegi, aap ka apna naam aur photos daal kar. Pasand na aaye to bilkul koi masla nahi.

English: I saw you have 406 Google reviews but no website, so I built you one - free. Video attached, live preview at the link above. Yours for PKR 15-25k if you want it.

- Aayan
